# Make repeated spaces-button construction idempotent after validation

Both spaces API modules iterate all registered extension spaces for a newly loaded window. createToolbarButton validates toolbar readiness and required values, then resolves early when document.getElementById(id) already exists. The duplicate guard does not bypass input validation or update existing button properties. Preserve that scoped contract across the old/new API window listeners. No add-on combination was tested. Static source and test inspection only. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending.

Scope: extension spaces toolbar.
